listing.subtitle: Find the details others miss
listing.promotionalText: Turn a park day into a hunt for hidden details, clues, and discoveries.
listing.description: Park Hunt is an independent theme-park scavenger hunt for spotting the details most guests walk past. Choose a hunt, reveal clues only when you need them, mark discoveries found, browse by park and land, and build a short route for your visit. Core hunting works offline with bundled content, and Nearby uses only a temporary foreground location fix when you explicitly open it. Park Hunt is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Disney or other venue operators.
